description:
Versatile titanium all-road. Exceptional value.
Discover the 2024 Enigma Etape, a versatile titanium all-road frame designed for riders who appreciate comfort, performance and the freedom to explore beyond smooth tarmac. Equally at home on long road rides, winter training routes and everyday adventures, the Etape combines the unmistakable ride quality of titanium with the practicality needed for year-round cycling.
Constructed from 3Al/2.5V titanium, the Etape features a beautifully brushed finish with contrasting satin bead logos. Its considered geometry delivers a comfortable, confident ride, while external cable routing, a threaded bottom bracket and mudguard compatibility make it an excellent choice for a dependable, easy-to-maintain all-road build.
SAVE 27% - WAS £2,199, NOW £1,599
With just a handful of these 2024 Etape frames remaining, we're offering them at a significant saving against their original retail price. Every frame is brand new and unused, complete with a full Enigma warranty.

Frame Only or Complete Build
The advertised price of £1,599 is for the titanium frame only, inclusive of the necessary frame fittings. Fork, headset and other components are not included.
For those looking to create a complete frameset, we can also supply the matching C-Six ARX carbon fork and Enigma A83 headset at additional cost.
Alternatively, our team can put together a complete Etape build tailored to your preferred groupset, wheels, finishing kit and budget. Simply get in touch to discuss the possibilities.
Availability
Last few frames remaining – limited sizes and quantities.
As these are the final remaining 2024 Etape frames, availability is strictly limited and subject to remaining stock.
Once they're gone, they're gone.
An excellent opportunity to build your own titanium all-road bike around a brand-new Enigma Etape frame, with a saving of £700 against the original retail price.
